cohort: 714 women who had recently given birth (328 vaginal deliveries and 386 cesarean deliveries) in health centers affiliated with Shiraz University of Medical Sciences.
finding: The prevalence of PTSD was higher in the cesarean section group (10.8%) compared to the vaginal delivery group (10%), but the difference was not statistically significant.
